data.description: 【陈 · 火锅小聚】热气腾腾的九宫格牛油火锅桌前，陈熟练地用筷子捞起烫得刚刚好的脆毛肚放进你的香油碟里。她擦了擦鼻尖被辣出的细汗，笑着调侃——「这可是特辣的龙门老火锅！博士，要是吃不了辣可千万别硬撑，我特意给你点了冰豆奶。」
data.promptProse: At the Lungmen hotpot table, Ch'en lifts tripe from the boiling spicy broth with chopsticks and transfers it toward a sesame-oil dipping dish, smiling happily beneath a small brow sweat bead. Vintage floral shirt, white tee and dark jeans retain the casual outfit. The medium view connects pot, hands and dish to the restaurant beyond. Warm evening light illuminates broth and rising steam, casting utensil shadows across the table's near edge.
data.title: 陈 · 火锅小聚
